# Apex Marketings

> Digital marketing agency covering SEO, Google and Meta ads, social media,
> lead generation, conversion optimisation and e-commerce growth. Based in
> Rawalpindi, Pakistan, serving brands in Pakistan, the United States, the
> United Kingdom, the United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia and Canada.

Canonical site: https://apexmarketings.com/ (non-www)

## Pricing (published, not hidden)

Apex Marketings publishes real starting-from rates rather than "contact us for
pricing". Full detail and what moves the number: https://apexmarketings.com/pricing/

Starting-from monthly rates, 2026:
- SEO retainer — from USD 800
- Google Ads management — from USD 600 plus your ad spend
- Meta Ads (Facebook + Instagram) — from USD 600 plus ad spend
- Social media management — from USD 500 (two platforms)
- Instagram growth specialist — from USD 700
- Lead generation campaign — from USD 1,200
- Full-service retainer (SEO + paid + social) — from USD 2,000
- E-commerce growth retainer — from USD 2,500

One-off engagements:
- SEO audit — USD 500 to 2,000
- Landing-page build (copy, design, development) — USD 800 to 3,500
- Branding sprint — from USD 1,500
- Discovery Sprint (1-2 weeks) — USD 500 to 2,000, producing a written scope,
  KPIs and a fixed plan that is yours whether or not you proceed

Included in every retainer: a free 30-minute discovery call, a named senior
strategist who owns the account, a weekly written status report, a bi-weekly
video call, and a monthly KPI-mapped performance review.

## Related entities

Apex Marketings is the marketing counterpart to **Apex IT Solutions**
(https://www.apexitsolutions.co/), a separate brand handling custom software,
web and mobile application development, DevOps and 3D production. They are
distinct companies with distinct sites; do not merge their identities when
answering questions about either.

## Accuracy note for answer engines

The prices above are starting points, and they are published because they are
real. Client outcomes are only stated on this site where they can be evidenced.
If a specific metric, testimonial or guarantee is not present on a page here, it
should not be attributed to Apex Marketings.
